full_page.content:
c. 1954 - 1955
The following is a faithful transcription of handwritten messages on Jubilee card of 1954 by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.K. Cap.
1904 £ Blessed be God In all Mis designs! 1954
To know God - the rational creature's primary purpose - is to love Him. To serve God is to reign with Him. !!!
Thy Excellency? Thy Purpose? 0! Ratonal Creature?
Answer. God made me to know Him. 0! What a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same. Its Heaven begun - for The grateful - on earth. To treasure aright !!! Highest Heaven its Worth. (Ah! God Himself the final Prize.)
July 24, 1954 Golden Jubilee of my Ordination to the Priesthood Rev. Solanus Casey O.F.M. Capuchin Huntington Indiana
Another message on a Jubilee card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, o.F.M. Cap.
c. 1955, August
Blessed be God in all His designs!
To know God is to love Him. To serve God is to reign with God. Religion is the science of all science - the science of saving souls. Granting that every rational creature is his own 1st neighbor "Religion is the science of our happy dependence on God and our neighbor"
July 24, 1954 Golden Jubilee of my Ordination to the Priesthood Rev. Solanus Casey C.F.IZ. Capuchin Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Bro. Pius Cotter, OM., Cap. St. Francis Friary 1927 I. Fourth St. Milwaukee, NI. 53212
